title: Yellowed Crunchy British Lamb Shepherds Pie
description: A hearty, dairy-free British dish featuring lamb, dark chocolate, and crunchy fried toppings, perfect for a cozy evening meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
In a large pan, heat the vegetable oil and fry the chopped onion and carrots until they are softened.
Add the lamb mince to the pan and cook until it is browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Stir in the dark chocolate chips and cook for a further 2 minutes.
In a separate pot, boil the chopped potatoes until they are tender, then drain and mash with the soy milk and a pinch of salt and pepper.
In a deep frying pan, heat a further 50ml of vegetable oil and fry the crushed tofu until it is crispy and golden brown.
In a large oven-proof dish, create a layer of the lamb mixture, followed by a layer of mashed potatoes, and finally a layer of the fried tofu on top.
Bake the shepherd's pie in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
Remove the pie from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
